title: Apollo's Song
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shogo, a young man whose abusive childhood left him hating love so much that he lashes out at any sign of affection, is placed in a psychiatric hospital; during electroshock treatment a stern goddess curses him to find and lose the same woman again and again (Kodansha USA blurb via AniList; Manga Critic review). The episodes move from Nazi Germany to a tropical island to a sexless cloned future society, and it is unclear which are real (review). Osamu Tezuka's 1970 shounen work, published in English by Vertical and Kodansha.
life_message: It insists that love, including bodily love, is sacred to life and that rejecting it destroys a person.

content.note: Shogo's cruelty to animals, a train bombing, wartime and sexual assault scenes (review); MangaUpdates Violence, Animal Cruelty, Violent Male Lead.
Repeated deaths of the beloved, dystopia, electroshock therapy (review); AniList Tragedy, Dystopian.
'Surprisingly carnal imagery', animals mating, opening sperm-and-egg sequence (review); MangaUpdates Nudity, Lust, Attempted Rape. Adult characters.
Psychiatric treatment and trauma from maternal abuse (review); suicide tagged by AniList and MangaUpdates (spoiler).
Animal cruelty by the protagonist (review; MangaUpdates).
